unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U27: Distinguish protected systems,nodal protection and cheque application

payload.title: Technical importance and statutory protected status differ
payload.core_explanation_md:
Critical information infrastructure is the described computer-resource category whose loss or destruction would have the specified debilitating national-security, economic, public-health or safety impact. Protected-system status involves the appropriate Government notification and authorised access framework. A manager calling a system critical does not replace that legal designation.

The national nodal-agency provision concerns critical-infrastructure protection. CERT-In and other statutory roles must be distinguished through their own provisions. The Act also has a specific electronic/truncated-cheque application route linked to the Negotiable Instruments Act definitions and Government notification in consultation with RBI. Do not infer that every scanned document is a legally equivalent cheque.

self_check.prompt_text: Does an internal critical label itself prove protected-system notification?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Check the statutory designation and access authority.

payload.stem_md: A compliance file claims protected-system status based only on an internal risk label. What evidence is central?

options.explanation_md: That does not establish statutory designation.
Security controls do not by themselves establish the legal status.

options.text_md: The relevant Government notification and authorised-access framework
options.explanation_md: Protected status is a statutory designation.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Protected status is a statutory designation.

payload.stem_md: A staff member treats every cheque photograph as a truncated cheque without examining the NI Act definition or applicable process. What is missing?

options.explanation_md: Resolution alone does not establish legal classification.

options.text_md: The statutory definition and applicable cheque-processing framework
options.explanation_md: A generic image label is insufficient.

options.text_md: A rule that electronic cheques can never exist

payload.correct_explanation_md: A generic image label is insufficient.
